'''''Sphagnum subnitens''''' is a species of [[moss]] belonging to the family [[Sphagnaceae]].<ref name="GBIF">{{cite web |title=Sphagnum subnitens Russow & Warnstorf, 1888 |url=https://www.gbif.org/species/2669053 |website=www.gbif.org |access-date=12 February 2021 |language=en}}</ref>

It has almost [[cosmopolitan distribution]].<ref name="GBIF" />

==Characteristics==
This moss type is known to form as either dense cushions or [[Hummock|hummocks]].<ref name="BBS-subnitens">{{cite web | title = ''Sphagnum subnitens var. subnitens'' | url = https://www.britishbryologicalsociety.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/Sphagnum-subnitens-var.-subnitens.pdf | website = British Bryological Society | access-date = 20 April 2026}}</ref>
 
==Habitat==
''Sphagnum subnitens'' occurs in several environments:<ref name="BBS-subnitens" />
*Boggy grassland
*Marshes
*Fens and Flushes
*Ditches
*Wet woodland
*Heather banks
*Blanket bogs
